name: restaurant-online-ordering
description: Single Restaurant Online Ordering & In-House Delivery System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,TELEGRAM" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "php -S localhost:8000 -t backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run telegram:poll"
scripts.preview: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,TELEGRAM" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "php -S localhost:8000 -t backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run telegram:poll"
scripts.prod: npm run build:frontend && npm run preview
